{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgEhMR6CU5sPBgyQuagck","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-Acct-Get.md ===\n# FEATURE: Account Get\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261021 V1 |\n| Description | Retrieve one account by code with `ledger account get`, writing its row or exiting 4 when absent. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-Acct-Add.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides    | ledger account get |\n| Consumes    | accounts.get |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nRead one account so an operator can check its name and current balance before posting or amending.\n\n## Command\n\n`ledger account get <code>`\n\n## Reads\n\n- `accounts.get` (FEATURE-LEDGER-002) with the account code as input.\n- The `transactions` count and `balance` are computed from the database at query time: the count of the account's transactions, and the sum of its transaction amounts in integer cents.\n\n## Output\n\nOn success, standard output is a header row and one data row, CSV, no quoting:\n\n```text\naccount,name,transactions,balance\n<code>,<name>,<transactions>,<balance>\n```\n\n`balance` is written with exactly two decimal places and a leading `-` when negative.\n\n## Exit Codes\n\n- `0` on success.\n- `4` when no account has the given code. Nothing is written to standard output; one diagnostic line goes to standard error.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC acct-get-roundtrip ===\nIntent: Account get returns the row written by account add, with the stored code and name and a zero balance.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\ninit_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert init_code == 0\n\ncode = \"TILL1\"\nname = \"Front Till\"\nadd_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code, name)\nassert add_code == 0\n\nget_code, get_out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", code)\nassert get_code == 0\nrows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(get_out)))\nassert rows[0] == [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\nassert rows[1][0] == code\nassert rows[1][1] == name\nassert rows[1][2] == \"0\"\nassert rows[1][3] == \"0.00\"\n=== END AC acct-get-roundtrip ===\n\n=== AC acct-get-absent-exits-4 ===\nIntent: Account get for a code that was never added exits 4 and writes nothing to standard output.\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\ninit_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert init_code == 0\n\nabsent = \"NOSUCH\"\nget_code, get_out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", absent)\nassert get_code == 4\nassert get_out == \"\"\n=== END AC acct-get-absent-exits-4 ===\n\n=== AC acct-get-is-read-only ===\nIntent: Account get writes nothing; the accounts row count is identical before and after a get.\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\ninit_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert init_code == 0\n\ncode = \"TILL1\"\nadd_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code, \"Front Till\")\nassert add_code == 0\n\nbefore_code, before_out, _ = cli_runner(\"count\")\nassert before_code == 0\nget_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", code)\nassert get_code == 0\nafter_code, after_out, _ = cli_runner(\"count\")\nassert after_code == 0\nassert after_out == before_out\n=== END AC acct-get-is-read-only ===\n\n=== AC acct-get-returns-own-row ===\nIntent: With two accounts present, account get for each code returns that account's own row and not the other's.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\ninit_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert init_code == 0\n\nfirst_code = \"TILL1\"\nfirst_name = \"Front Till\"\nsecond_code = \"TILL2\"\nsecond_name = \"Back Till\"\nadd_first, _, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", first_code, first_name)\nassert add_first == 0\nadd_second, _, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", second_code, second_name)\nassert add_second == 0\n\nfirst_get, first_out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", first_code)\nassert first_get == 0\nfirst_rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(first_out)))\nassert first_rows[1][0] == first_code\nassert first_rows[1][1] == first_name\n\nsecond_get, second_out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", second_code)\nassert second_get == 0\nsecond_rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(second_out)))\nassert second_rows[1][0] == second_code\nassert second_rows[1][1] == second_name\n=== END AC acct-get-returns-own-row ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Account get never writes to any table.\n- The balance and transaction count are computed from the database; they are never stored on or copied into the account row.\n- An absent code exits 4, never 0 with an empty row.\n\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-Acct-Rename.md ===\n# FEATURE: Account Rename\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261021 V1 |\n| Description | Rename an existing account with `ledger account rename`, writing the updated row or exiting 4 when absent. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-Acct-Add.md, FEATURE-Acct-Get.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides    | ledger account rename |\n| Consumes    | accounts.get, accounts.update |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nChange the display name of an account. The code, the transactions, and the balance are not affected.\n\n## Command\n\n`ledger account rename <code> <name>`\n\n## Reads and Writes\n\n- Reads the account with `accounts.get` (FEATURE-LEDGER-002) to decide whether it exists.\n- Writes only the name with `accounts.update` (FEATURE-LEDGER-004).\n- The name is validated before any write: 1 to 40 characters, with no comma and no newline.\n\n## Output\n\nOn success, standard output is the header row and the updated account row, in the form of `account,name,transactions,balance`.\n\n## Exit Codes\n\n- `0` on success.\n- `3` when the name fails validation. Nothing is written.\n- `4` when no account has the given code. Nothing is written; one diagnostic line goes to standard error.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC acct-rename-roundtrip ===\nIntent: After rename, the returned row and a subsequent account get both carry the new name, and the code is unchanged.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\ninit_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert init_code == 0\n\ncode = \"TILL1\"\nold_name = \"Front Till\"\nnew_name = \"Event Till\"\nadd_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code, old_name)\nassert add_code == 0\n\nrename_code, rename_out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"rename\", code, new_name)\nassert rename_code == 0\nrename_rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(rename_out)))\nassert rename_rows[0] == [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\nassert rename_rows[1][0] == code\nassert rename_rows[1][1] == new_name\n\nget_code, get_out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", code)\nassert get_code == 0\nget_rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(get_out)))\nassert get_rows[1][0] == code\nassert get_rows[1][1] == new_name\n=== END AC acct-rename-roundtrip ===\n\n=== AC acct-rename-changes-only-name ===\nIntent: Rename changes only the name; the transactions count and balance read back unchanged.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\ninit_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert init_code == 0\n\ncode = \"TILL1\"\nold_name = \"Front Till\"\nnew_name = \"Event Till\"\nadd_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code, old_name)\nassert add_code == 0\n\nbefore_code, before_out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", code)\nassert before_code == 0\nbefore_row = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(before_out)))[1]\n\nrename_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"rename\", code, new_name)\nassert rename_code == 0\n\nafter_code, after_out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", code)\nassert after_code == 0\nafter_row = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(after_out)))[1]\n\nassert after_row[0] == before_row[0]\nassert after_row[1] == new_name\nassert after_row[2] == before_row[2]\nassert after_row[3] == before_row[3]\n=== END AC acct-rename-changes-only-name ===\n\n=== AC acct-rename-absent-exits-4 ===\nIntent: Renaming an account that does not exist exits 4 and writes nothing to standard output.\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\ninit_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert init_code == 0\n\nabsent = \"NOSUCH\"\nnew_name = \"Event Till\"\nrename_code, rename_out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"rename\", absent, new_name)\nassert rename_code == 4\nassert rename_out == \"\"\n=== END AC acct-rename-absent-exits-4 ===\n\n=== AC acct-rename-invalid-name-exits-3 ===\nIntent: A name with a comma, or longer than 40 characters, is rejected with exit 3 and the stored name is unchanged.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\ninit_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert init_code == 0\n\ncode = \"TILL1\"\nold_name = \"Front Till\"\nadd_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code, old_name)\nassert add_code == 0\n\ncomma_name = \"Event, Till\"\ncomma_code, comma_out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"rename\", code, comma_name)\nassert comma_code == 3\nassert comma_out == \"\"\n\nlong_name = \"x\" * 41\nlong_code, long_out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"rename\", code, long_name)\nassert long_code == 3\nassert long_out == \"\"\n\nget_code, get_out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", code)\nassert get_code == 0\nget_rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(get_out)))\nassert get_rows[1][1] == old_name\n=== END AC acct-rename-invalid-name-exits-3 ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- A rejected or absent rename changes nothing.\n- Rename never alters the account code, the transactions, or the balance.\n\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-Acct-Delete.md ===\n# FEATURE: Account Delete\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261021 V1 |\n| Description | Delete an account with `ledger account delete`, refused while the account has transactions and exiting 4 when absent. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-Acct-Add.md, FEATURE-Txn-Post.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides    | ledger account delete |\n| Consumes    | accounts.get, transactions.list, accounts.delete |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nRemove an account that is no longer used. An account that still owns transactions is never removed, so no transaction is left pointing at a missing account.\n\n## Command\n\n`ledger account delete <code>`\n\n## Reads and Writes\n\n- Reads the account with `accounts.get` (FEATURE-LEDGER-002). If absent, the command exits 4.\n- Reads the account's transactions with `transactions.list` (FEATURE-LEDGER-011). If any exist, the command exits 3 and changes nothing.\n- Otherwise removes the account with `accounts.delete` (FEATURE-LEDGER-005).\n\n## Output\n\nOn success, standard output is two lines: `deleted`, then the code.\n\n## Exit Codes\n\n- `0` on success.\n- `3` when the account has one or more transactions. The account is left in place and nothing is written.\n- `4` when no account has the given code. Nothing is written; one diagnostic line goes to standard error.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC acct-delete-empty-account ===\nIntent: Deleting an account with no transactions writes deleted and the code, and afterward the code is free to add again.\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\ninit_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert init_code == 0\nload_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", \"sources/seed_categories.csv\")\nassert load_code == 0\n\ncode = \"TILL1\"\nadd_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code, \"Front Till\")\nassert add_code == 0\n\ndelete_code, delete_out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"delete\", code)\nassert delete_code == 0\nassert delete_out.splitlines() == [\"deleted\", code]\n\nreadd_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code, \"Front Till\")\nassert readd_code == 0\n=== END AC acct-delete-empty-account ===\n\n=== AC acct-delete-in-use-refused ===\nIntent: Deleting an account that has a transaction exits 3, writes nothing, and leaves the account in place, which a further transaction post confirms.\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\ninit_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert init_code == 0\nload_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", \"sources/seed_categories.csv\")\nassert load_code == 0\n\ncode = \"TILL1\"\ncategory = \"SALES\"\namount = \"10.00\"\ndate = \"2026-01-02\"\nmemo = \"walk in sale\"\nadd_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code, \"Front Till\")\nassert add_code == 0\npost_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", code, category, amount, date, memo)\nassert post_code == 0\n\ndelete_code, delete_out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"delete\", code)\nassert delete_code == 3\nassert delete_out == \"\"\n\nfollow_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", code, category, amount, date, memo)\nassert follow_code == 0\n=== END AC acct-delete-in-use-refused ===\n\n=== AC acct-delete-absent-exits-4 ===\nIntent: Deleting an account that does not exist exits 4 and writes nothing to standard output.\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\ninit_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert init_code == 0\n\nabsent = \"NOSUCH\"\ndelete_code, delete_out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"delete\", absent)\nassert delete_code == 4\nassert delete_out == \"\"\n=== END AC acct-delete-absent-exits-4 ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- A refused or absent delete changes nothing.\n- No transaction is ever left referencing a missing account.\n\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-Txn-Post.md ===\n# FEATURE: Transaction Post\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261021 V1 |\n| Description | Post one cash transaction with `ledger txn post`, validating every input and balance rule before the single write. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-Acct-Add.md, FEATURE-Load-Categories.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides    | ledger txn post |\n| Consumes    | accounts.get, categories.get, transactions.list, transactions.create |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nRecord one receipt or payment against an account and category. This is the only way a new transaction enters the ledger outside loading and transfers.\n\n## Command\n\n`ledger txn post <account> <category> <amount> <date> [<memo>]`\n\n## Validation\n\nAll of the following are checked before the first write. Any failure exits 3 and writes nothing.\n\n- `account` exists (`accounts.get`); an unknown account is rejected.\n- `category` exists (`categories.get`); an unknown category is rejected.\n- `amount` matches `-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`: at most two decimal places, never zero. It is stored as integer cents.\n- `date` is a real calendar date written `YYYY-MM-DD`.\n- `memo` is 0 to 60 characters, with no comma and no newline. An absent memo is stored as empty.\n- The account balance after the post is not below zero. The balance is the sum of the account's transaction amounts, computed from `transactions.list`.\n\n## Transaction Id\n\nThe new row receives one more than the largest `txn_id` present (`transactions.list`), or `1` when the table is empty. Ids are never reused.\n\n## Output\n\nOn success, standard output is the header row and the new row:\n\n```text\ntxn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo\n<id>,<date>,<account>,<category>,<amount>,<memo>\n```\n\n`amount` is written with exactly two decimal places.\n\n## Exit Codes\n\n- `0` on success.\n- `3` for any validation or balance failure above. Nothing is written.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-post-roundtrip-fields ===\nIntent: A posted transaction's returned row carries the supplied date, account, category, amount, and memo, and its first id is 1.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\ninit_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert init_code == 0\nload_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", \"sources/seed_categories.csv\")\nassert load_code == 0\n\naccount = \"TILL1\"\ncategory = \"SALES\"\namount = \"45.50\"\ndate = \"2026-04-01\"\nmemo = \"walk in sale\"\nadd_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", account, \"Front Till\")\nassert add_code == 0\n\npost_code, post_out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", account, category, amount, date, memo)\nassert post_code == 0\nrows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(post_out)))\nassert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\nassert rows[1][0] == \"1\"\nassert rows[1][1] == date\nassert rows[1][2] == account\nassert rows[1][3] == category\nassert rows[1][4] == amount\nassert rows[1][5] == memo\n=== END AC txn-post-roundtrip-fields ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-id-sequence ===\nIntent: Each post receives one more than the largest id present, so the second post's id is the first's plus one.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\ninit_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert init_code == 0\nload_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", \"sources/seed_categories.csv\")\nassert load_code == 0\n\naccount = \"TILL1\"\ncategory = \"SALES\"\namount = \"10.00\"\ndate = \"2026-04-01\"\nadd_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", account, \"Front Till\")\nassert add_code == 0\n\nfirst_code, first_out, accounts.get |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nRead one account so an operator can check its name and current balance before posting or amending.\n\n## Command\n\n`ledger account get <code>`\n\n## Reads\n\n- `accounts.get` (FEATURE-LEDGER-002) with the account code as input.\n- The `transactions` count and `balance` are computed from the database at query time: the count of the account's transactions, and the sum of its transaction amounts in integer cents.\n\n## Output\n\nOn success, standard output is a header row and one data row, CSV, no quoting:\n\n```text\naccount,name,transactions,balance\n<code>,<name>,<transactions>,<balance>\n```\n\n`balance` is written with exactly two decimal places and a leading `-` when negative.\n\n## Exit os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\ninit_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"init\")\nassert init_code == 0\n\ncode = \"TILL1\"\nname = \"Front Till\"\nadd_code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", Delete\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261021 V1 |\n| Description | Delete an account with `ledger account delete`, refused while the account has transactions and exiting 4 when absent. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-Acct-Add.md, FEATURE-Txn-Post.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides    | ledger account delete |\n| Consumes    | accounts.get, transactions.list, accounts.delete |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nRemove an account that is no longer used. An account that still owns transactions is never removed, so no transaction is left pointing at a missing account.\n\n## Command\n\n`ledger account delete <code>`\n\n## Reads and Writes\n\n- Reads the account with `accounts.get` (FEATURE-LEDGER-002). If absent, the command exits 4.\n- Reads the account's transactions with `transactions.list` (FEATURE-LEDGER-011). If any exist, the command exits 3 and changes nothing.\n- Otherwise removes the account with `accounts.delete` (FEATURE-LEDGER-005).\n\n## Output\n\nOn success, standard output is two lines: `deleted`, then the code.\n\n## Exit Codes\n\n- `0` on success.\n- `3` when the account has one or more transactions. The account is left in place and nothing is written.\n- `4` when no account has the given code. Nothing is written; one diagnostic line goes to standard error.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC acct-delete-empty-account ===\nIntent: Deleting an account with no transactions writes deleted FEATURE: Transaction Post\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261021 V1 |\n| Description | Post one cash transaction with `ledger txn post`, validating every input and balance rule before the single write. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-Acct-Add.md, FEATURE-Load-Categories.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides    | ledger txn post |\n| Consumes    | accounts.get, categories.get, transactions.list, transactions.create |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nRecord one receipt or payment against an account and category. This is the only way a new transaction enters the ledger outside loading and transfers.\n\n## Command\n\n`ledger txn post <account> <category> <amount> <date> [<memo>]`\n\n## Validation\n\nAll of the following are checked before the first write. Any failure exits 3 and writes nothing.\n\n- `account` exists (`accounts.get`); an unknown account is rejected.\n- `category` exists (`categories.get`); an unknown category is rejected.\n- `amount` matches `-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`: at most two decimal places, never zero. It is stored as integer cents.\n- `date` is a real calendar date written `YYYY-MM-DD`.\n- `memo` is 0 to 60 characters, with no comma and no newline. An absent memo is stored as empty.\n- The account balance after the post is not below zero. The balance is the sum of the account's transaction amounts, computed from `transactions.list`.\n\n## Transaction Id\n\nThe new row receives one more than the largest `txn_id` present (`transactions.list`), or `1` when the table is empty. Ids are never reused.\n\n## Output\n\nOn success, standard output is the header row and the new row:\n\n```text\ntxn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo\n<id>,<date>,<account>,<category>,<amount>,<memo>\n```\n\n`amount` is written with exactly two decimal places.\n\n## Exit Codes\n\n- `0` on success.\n- `3` for any validation or balance failure above. with `ledger txn get`, writing its row or exiting 4 when absent. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-Txn-Post.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides    | ledger txn get |\n| Consumes    | transactions.get |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nRead one transaction so an operator can confirm what was recorded.\n\n## Command\n\n`ledger txn get <id>`\n\n## Reads\n\n- `transactions.get` (FEATURE-LEDGER-010) with the id as input.\n- No writes.\n\n## Output\n\nOn success, standard output is the header row and the transaction row:\n\n```text\ntxn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo\n<id>,<date>,<account>,<category>,<amount>,<memo>\n```\n\n`amount` is written with exactly two decimal places and a leading `-` when negative.\n\n## Exit Codes\n\n- `0` on success.\n- `4` when no transaction has the given id. Nothing is written to standard output; one diagnostic line goes to standard error.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-get-roundtrip ===\nIntent: The row returned by txn get for a posted id
